summary: A user accidentally swapped Litecoin into USDT on the Tron network through Exodus and later discovered additional TRX tokens were required to move or convert the funds. The user lacked understanding of network gas requirements and became unable to access the funds without acquiring TRX.
user_mistake: swapping assets onto an unfamiliar blockchain network without understanding gas requirements
prevention: learn destination network fee requirements before swaps/keep native gas tokens available before transferring stablecoins
